pipeline.modality: Oral RaniPill HC capsule containing peptide drug substance
pipeline.target: GLP-1/GLP-2 dual agonist (PG-102, in-licensed from ProGen)
pipeline.license_origin: Worldwide collaboration with ProGen Co., Ltd.

indications.trial_design: Single-center Phase 1 in Australia; single-dose and multiple-dose evaluation of safety, tolerability, bioavailability, PK/PD; cohorts comparing oral RaniPill capsule (12 mg PG-102) vs subcutaneous PG-102 in healthy participants

pipeline.modality: Oral RaniPill capsule containing biosimilar antibody
pipeline.license_origin: License and supply agreement with Celltrion

indications.indication: Inflammatory conditions (psoriasis, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis)
indications.trial_design: Single-center, open-label Phase 1 in healthy adult volunteers in Australia evaluating safety/tolerability of single doses of RT-111 (0.5 mg, 0.75 mg) vs SC STELARA (0.5 mg)
indications.trial_status: COMPLETED (positive topline Feb 2024); next step is to advance with RaniPill HC
key_milestones: Bioavailability 84% for 0.5 mg RT-111 vs SC STELARA
